security.heading: Your finances deserve clarity and care.

items.title: Secure authentication
items.description: Passwords are hashed, never stored in plain text, and sessions expire automatically after a period of inactivity.

items.title: Private financial information
items.description: Your transactions, budgets, and reports are tied to your account and only visible when you're signed in.

items.title: Controlled access
items.description: Every request to your data requires a valid, signed session — there's no shared or anonymous access.

items.title: Responsible data handling
items.description: Password reset links expire after an hour, and inactive sessions are ended automatically rather than left open.

designPhilosophy.heading: Designed around real budgeting challenges
designPhilosophy.description: BudgetMate was built around problems students and young professionals actually run into when managing money day to day.

items.title: Small expenses add up unnoticed
items.description: A few cedis here and there on data, transport, or food rarely feels significant in the moment.

items.title: Overspending is realised too late
items.description: Without a running total, it's easy to only notice a budget is blown after the fact.

items.title: Monthly habits stay invisible
items.description: Bank and Mobile Money statements show transactions — rarely a clear picture of where it all went.

items.question: Is BudgetMate free to use?
items.answer: Yes. Creating an account and using the core budgeting, tracking, and reporting features is free.

items.question: Does it support Mobile Money?
items.answer: Yes — Mobile Money is one of the payment methods you can log transactions against, alongside cash, bank transfers, and cards.

items.question: Is my financial data private?
items.answer: Your transactions, budgets, and reports are tied to your account and only accessible once you're signed in.

items.question: Can I use BudgetMate on my phone?
items.answer: Yes — the app is fully responsive and works in any modern mobile browser, no separate app install needed.
